notes.title: Demo version available
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Got some cool news! We’re dropping the game demo, and now it’s open to everyone — so anyone can check out what’s waiting for us!  

Go grab it, download it, and see how it feels wandering with Jimmy through those mysterious streets, searching for a way home. We’re really eager to hear what you think, so don’t hold back — share your impressions, feedback, or even any bugs you come across.

If for some reason the previous version of the game did not start or slowed down a lot, try updating the game to the current version

Stay updated and chat with us:  

X (Twitter)

Discord

YouTube  

And don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist — it’d seriously help us out a ton!

notes.title: UPDATE IS LIVE! 🎮✨
notes.notes:
UPDATE IS LIVE! 🎮✨

Friends, we’re thrilled to announce the second wave of testing! Access is now granted to everyone who requested it. Alongside this, we’ve rolled out an update packed with fixes to enhance your gameplay experience. With your help, we’ve gathered tons of feedback, but this update focuses on the most frequent issues:

Improved Controls: “Random falls” are now much rarer. We’ve trained Jimmy to be steadier on narrow surfaces and jump higher/farther. The throw cursor is less likely to vanish, and controller movements feel more responsive.

Locations: Fixed issues in certain areas and cutscenes for smoother gameplay.

Added Achievements: You asked, we delivered! We’ve also added exclusive achievements only for testers.

Bugs: Conducted a massive cleanup across all locations.

Graphics: Reduced “blurriness” for sharper, cleaner visuals.

STREAMS & DISCUSSIONS 🚀
We allow and encourage streams, reviews, and discussions about the playtest! Share your excitement, report bugs, and tell us what you love (or don’t). Your feedback drives us!

WHAT’S NEXT? 🔧
We’ll keep rolling out fixes. Once we’ve polished the most critical areas, the game will launch as a free demo for everyone to play!

THANK YOU! ❤️
A massive thanks to everyone participating in the playtest. Your support and feedback help us improve daily. Let’s create something truly awesome together!

Happy gaming, and keep the feedback coming!
— The Cyberhead Team 🎉

notes.title: ONE WAY HOME. Demo version of the game is already available
notes.notes: A twelve-year-old boy, Jimmy, searches for his way home to his mom at the very beginning of the apocalypse. Join him on an atmospheric journey filled with the unknown

notes.title: Demo version is coming soon
notes.notes:
Hi!

Thank you for adding the game to your Wishlist, I really appreciate it.

We are now working day and night to get the demo ready for release, and I hope we don't disappoint you. 

We will only show a small part of Jimmy's journey, give you a chance to use some mechanics and solve puzzles. The demo may differ from the release version, and the narrative may change as well.

Tentative release date August 2023

If you haven't added the game to your wishlist yet, be sure to do so - the journey will be full of dangers, unexpected plot twists and very exciting

With a huge thank you for your support, 
Cyberhead team
